source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution 1920x1080) and seconds

visible_window.note: Object pixels only ever appear inside x = 94..1833 (the segmentation crop); parts of objects outside this band are cut to white. Edges touching x=94 or x=1833 are clipped, not real object ends.

camera.motion: assumed static (Blender clip, fixed camera per benchmark). No background survives segmentation, so this cannot be checked against scenery; both vehicles keep a constant image row and constant apparent size, consistent with a fixed camera.
camera.view: side view of the vehicles' travel direction; vehicles drive right-to-left roughly parallel to the image plane. In the right part of the frame (x > ~1400) the vehicles are also seen slightly from the front (front faces / headlights visible) = off-axis perspective.
camera.ground_plane_cues: No ground visible. Car tyre bottoms at y = 882 (nearer vehicle), cart tyre bottoms at y = 818 (farther vehicle, behind the car). Lower ground contact for the nearer object => camera above the ground looking roughly horizontally / slightly down; horizon is above y = 818 but cannot be located.
camera.apparent_size_vs_time: Constant for both moving objects: car height 354 px (frames 17-35), car length 1152-1160 px (frames 22-27); cart length 370-375 px and height 328 px (frames 31-41), cart roof/bottom rows unchanged since frame 0 (roof y 513, wheels y 816-818). => both move at (nearly) constant camera depth; image motion is horizontal only.

objects.name: car
objects.description: yellow/gold two-door sports coupe with rear spoiler, black windows, silver 5-spoke wheels
objects.distinguishing: yellow body; the large nearer vehicle (in front of the cart, occludes it); tyres reach y=882
objects.visible_frames: 0-37 (frames 0-21 rear clipped by window at x=1833; 22-27 fully visible; 28-37 front clipped at x=94; 38-39 only a blurred brown segmentation blob of its rear; absent 40-41)
objects.reference_point: estimated centre of the side-view bounding box: cx = (front+rear)/2 when both ends visible, else visible end -/+ L/2 with L = 1153.5 px; cy = 705 (midpoint of roof y 528 and tyre bottom y 882)

objects.name: cart
objects.description: small light-blue utility/golf-cart-like vehicle with a flat roof on posts, open cab with a dark-blue seat, grey cargo box at the rear, a slanted rod/post rising above the rear of the roof, small black wheels
objects.distinguishing: blue colour; smaller and farther from the camera than the car (behind it); wheels reach only y=818
objects.visible_frames: 0-41 (always partly visible: frames 0-14 rear clipped by window and/or front hidden by the car; 8-31 largely occluded by the car - only the roof and rear post visible above the car; 32-41 fully visible)
objects.reference_point: estimated centre of side-view bbox: cx = (front+rear)/2 for frames 32-41; earlier frames from roof-front tip and rear-post tip with offsets calibrated on frames 32-41; cy = 654 (midpoint of bbox y 490..818 incl. rear post) - body-only centre would be y 665 (roof 513..wheels 818)

static_objects: none - the background was removed by segmentation (white); no ground, road markings, or furniture are visible

events.event: both vehicles start from (near) rest at the start of the clip
events.note: car front moves 4 px between frames 0-1, cart ~1 px; both then accelerate

events.event: car nose passes the cart's front (car begins to overtake, passing in front of the cart)
car rear end passes the cart's rear end
car nose leaves the visible window at x=94
car fully overtakes cart (car tail passes cart front; cart unoccluded from here)
car segmentation degrades to a blurred blob, then disappears

image speed of both vehicles peaks around frames 25-33 and then decreases slightly to the end (ease-in/ease-out-like motion); no direction changes, no contacts or collisions (car passes in front of the cart at a different depth)

files.tracks/car.csv: per-frame car reference point, visible and estimated full bboxes, flags
files.tracks/cart.csv: per-frame cart reference point, visible and estimated full bboxes, flags
files.raw/features.json: raw per-frame mask extents and feature x-positions (output of scripts/features.py)
files.raw/build_constants.json: lengths and offsets used to estimate centres
